mapper.select: select goods.*,ip.ipName,brand.brandName from goodscollection.goods inner join goodscollection.ip on goods.ipId = ip.ipId inner join goodscollection.brand on goods.brandId = brand.brandId where goodsId=#{goodsId}
select goods.*,ip.ipName,brand.brandName from goodscollection.goods inner join goodscollection.ip on goods.ipId = ip.ipId inner join goodscollection.brand on goods.brandId = brand.brandId
select goods.* from goodscollection.goods inner join goodscollection.productassociations on goods.goodsId = productassociations.goodsId where personaId=#{personaId}
select goods.* from goodscollection.goods inner join goodscollection.publish on goods.goodsId = publish.goodsId where userId = #{userId}
select goodsImgUrl from goodscollection.goodsimg where goodsId=#{goodsId} order by id asc
